title: Clerk removed afterSwitchOrganizationUrl
description: Clerk Core 3 removes the afterSwitchOrganizationUrl prop from OrganizationSwitcher and directs applications to use afterSelectOrganizationUrl instead.
oldBehavior: OrganizationSwitcher receives the removed afterSwitchOrganizationUrl prop.
newBehavior: OrganizationSwitcher uses the documented afterSelectOrganizationUrl prop.
migrationInstructions: Replace a direct JSX afterSwitchOrganizationUrl attribute with afterSelectOrganizationUrl.
Keep wrapper components, dynamic prop forwarding, and behavioral routing changes under human review.

evidenceSources.summary: Official Clerk Core 3 upgrade guidance identifies afterSwitchOrganizationUrl as removed and afterSelectOrganizationUrl as the replacement.

review.notes: Reviewed against the official Clerk Core 3 guide. The executable transformation is limited to direct JSX attribute renames; wrappers and behavior remain review-only.

assumptions: The source establishes the named OrganizationSwitcher prop boundary but not wrapper behavior.
Only direct JSX attributes are eligible for a deterministic proposal.
Every generated patch remains subject to verification and human approval.
